scripts.build:all: mkdir -p dist && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/database-tools.exe && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/database-tools-linux && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/database-tools-macos-arm64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/database-tools-macos-x64
scripts.build:zip: cd dist && zip -j -9 database-tools-windows-x64.zip database-tools.exe && zip -j -9 database-tools-linux-x64.zip database-tools-linux && zip -j -9 database-tools-macos-arm64.zip database-tools-macos-arm64 && zip -j -9 database-tools-macos-x64.zip database-tools-macos-x64 && ls -lh *.zip
scripts.build:all:zip: bun run build:all && bun run build:zip
